prefs.anti_aliasing_amd_dx12: Anti-aliasing uses 1× because the startup check drew nothing with multisampling and passed at 1×. You can choose another setting above; restart to apply it if the check passes.
prefs.context_menu_ring: Context menu · hold for the radial menu
prefs.extra_navigation: Ctrl+left drag on empty space orbits; hold Space to pan.
prefs.font_fallback: Glyphs the chosen font lacks fall back to the built-in font, so no label shows an empty box.
prefs.font_sample: The quick brown fox · Ø12.50 mm · 45.0° · 0123456789
prefs.font_unreadable: The selected font could not be read.
prefs.graphics_card_missing: The saved graphics card is unavailable; Automatic is used.
prefs.graphics_card_restart: Takes effect after restarting SolidCraft. WGPU_ADAPTER_NAME overrides this choice.
prefs.history_origin_bodies_note: The History on the left or under the browser starts with the active component's Bodies folder and the Origin, with their eyes and menus as in the browser. The History at the bottom is unchanged.
prefs.history_sketches_note: With Sketches set to Under their feature, the History at the left lists each sketch one level in, under the first feature built from it, whenever it is wide enough for names. The timeline at the bottom always keeps the creation order.
prefs.orbit_snap: Hold Shift during orbit to snap to an axis.
prefs.scale_note: Also Ctrl + / Ctrl − in the window. Buttons are 28 px at 100%.
prefs.view_confirm_corner_note: While a dialog or a sketch is open, a check and a cross at the top right of the view do what the dialog's OK and Cancel do, or finish and cancel the sketch. The view navigator moves down below them.
